_comment: Synthetic RAG corpus for the Berlin scenario. Two indexes are mixed via the 'index' field: 'live' = daily ingest (ages out), 'case' = curated memory (never expires). Notable didactic documents: (forum:redwing) a 14-month-old CASE-memory surveillance post by @drk_wolf with NO threat words, which grounds the 'with-retrieval' assessment; (social:handle-probe) a recent post whose only strong signal is the exact handle @drk_wolf, which LEXICAL search catches but the concept embedder blurs; (social:wrong-vale) a violent post about a DIFFERENT executive (morgan_vale) that the entity_id pre-filter must exclude; (exposure:broker-hit) a PII-class doc the public retrieval path must not see.

documents.title: Vantage Robotics faces backlash over factory automation plans
documents.text:
Vantage Robotics drew sharp criticism this week after its chief executive, Jordan Vale, announced a sweeping warehouse automation program.

Unions say the rollout will cut hundreds of jobs across three facilities. Organizers have promised to bring their objections to Vale's upcoming public appearances in Europe.

The company defended the plan as necessary for competitiveness, but the announcement has fueled a wave of negative coverage and online anger directed at the CEO personally.

documents.title: After-action note — Munich keynote 2025
documents.text:
During the 2025 Munich keynote, protective detail flagged a small group affiliated with Open Sky Collective gathered near the venue's delegate entrance.

One individual, later associated with the handle drk_wolf, remained outside the Kongresszentrum for roughly two hours after the event concluded and was observed noting the movements of vehicles at the parking exit.

No contact was attempted and no offence was committed, so the matter was logged for pattern awareness rather than escalated. The note was retained in case the same individual resurfaced at a future appearance.
